notes.title: Demo 0.4! Rebalancing and D-pad support!
notes.notes:
[h1]A Huge Thank You for All Your Feedback This Past Month! We Heard You![/h1]

It’s been a whole month since the Poradora vs Monsters of the World demo launched! Some of you love the challenge while others found it so frustrating you may or may not have rage-quit. Either way, we’ve been listening, reading, and making notes in between crying over your brutally honest feedback. 😂

So guess what? Changes have been made! We're striving for that sweet middle ground where fun meets "I can actually beat this." Here’s what’s new:

[h2]- D-Pad Support![/h2]
Yes, we admit it—we goofed big time. D-pad support was glaringly absent, but now you can enjoy pixel-perfect precision while controlling Poradora. Go ahead, flex those thumbs!

[h2]- Boss Battle Tweaks![/h2]
We heard you: the first-stage boss went full Dark Souls on you, and that wasn’t cool. Now:
[list]
[*] The boss attacks one at a time with rest breaks in between, no more spamming attacks back to back!
[*] Stomp attacks won't crush you if you're chilling on the flying platform.
[*] And the hitbox for its head is smaller—you got more room to jump now!
[/list]
[h2]- Knockback? Toned Down![/h2]
Remember that Castlevania-style knockback where one tiny hit sent you flying into the void like Team Rocket blasting off again? Yeah, that’s gone. No more dying in the flying platforms section; you’ve got a real fighting chance now!

[h2]- Invincibility Frames Boosted![/h2]
Getting smacked around like a pinball between projectiles wasn’t fun (for you or us watching playtest videos). Damage invincibility is now 1.3 seconds instead of 1.0. That extra 0.3 seconds is for your sanity.

[h2]- Wall Jump Fixes![/h2]
We’ve all been there: you’re trying to wall-jump like a ninja, but oops—you pressed the wrong direction and fell. Not anymore! Now, Poradora will cling to walls even if your fingers betray you. If you [b]DO[/b] want to slide down, just press the down button. Easy peasy!

[h2]- No More Crashes![/h2]
The bug causing mini-boss battles to crash? Squashed. Gone. Sent to the shadow realm. Your boss fights will now proceed crash-free.

[h3]- We’re on Steam event![/h3]
Big news: we’re joining our first Steam event! 🎉
👉[url=https://t.co/V5dy6PlBYL]Check out the SEAGO Steam Sale 2024[/url]

notes.title: Demo 0.2 update and fixes!
notes.notes:
[b]A Huge Thank You to Everyone Who Played the PORADORA vs. Monsters of the World 0.1 Demo![/b]

We want to express our heartfelt thanks to everyone who jumped in and played the demo this past week! Your feedback, bug reports, and gameplay clips have been absolutely invaluable. We’ve made some exciting updates in response to your input, and we’ve even managed to fix a few bugs that we wouldn’t have caught without your help. Here’s a rundown of the changes in this update:

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[list]
[*] [b]Xbox Controller Drift: [/b]
[/list]We’ve addressed the issue where players were slightly drifting to the right while using an Xbox controller. We’ve added the necessary dead zone to fix this—apologies for missing it earlier!
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
[olist]
[list]
[*] [b]Projectile Energy Boost:[/b]
[/list] We’ve increased the maximum projectile energy from 3 to 5, so now you can [i]PEW-PEW[/i] to your heart’s content!
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial Stage Overhaul:[/b]
[/list] We’ve made some design changes to the tutorial stage to make it more user-friendly and less frustrating for new players.
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial Enhancements:[/b]
[/list] We’ve added helpful tips in the tutorial to emphasize the importance of sliding and charging your shot—key mechanics that will give you the upper hand!
[/olist]

[b]Sprite Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cleopatra’s Corpse Sprite:[/b]
[/list]A slight adjustment has been made to Cleopatra’s corpse sprite to improve its look.
[list]
[*] [b]Poradora’s Sprite Fixes:[/b]
[/list]We’ve patched up some noticeable holes in Poradora’s sprite that were visible inside the pyramid—no more distractions while exploring!


[b]Boss Battle Strategy:[/b]
We’ve noticed that many players are having a tough time with the boss battle, so we’ve put together a strategy guide to help you out! Check out the video below for some tips and tricks to conquer the challenge.
[previewyoutube=TGyUJXoyTaw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What's Next?[/b]
We’re just getting started! Expect more updates and rebalancing in the future as we continue to polish the game. Your feedback is crucial to making PORADORA vs. Monsters of the World the best it can be, so keep it coming. Thanks again for your support—we couldn't do it without you!
